variety_description: Early maturity, semi-dwarf variety with average grain yield was developed by IGKVV, Raipur, and released in 2007. Recommended for direct seeding in upland and in rainfed lowland bunded ecology of Chhattisgarh plains. Popular among farmers due to its medium slender heavy grain, resistance to gall midge, and tolerance to leaf blast and brown spot. It has high amylose content, medium gel consistency, and desirable alkali spreading value.
